titolo: How to search your own files by meaning with Ollama, on your PC
descr: Build a free tool that finds text files, photos and voice memos by meaning with Ollama and EmbeddingGemma 2. The full script, every command and where it failed.
paragrafi: A normal search looks for the exact words, so a search for moving out found nothing in our test folder.
Download EmbeddingGemma 2 with Ollama, save a script of about 60 lines and index a test folder. Thirteen files took about 5 seconds.
The meaning search put the right file first for a lease question, a dog photo, a train ticket and a voice memo.
It can fail: it missed our mountain photo, and it always shows three results, even when nothing matches.
To remove it, run ollama rm and delete index.json.
perche: The script does not read PDF or Word files, and we did not test video files, MP3 audio, a whole hard disk or a run with the network unplugged.
